purpose: Prevent accidental GitHub Actions spend before the alpha.3 integration tree is final.

safeRemoteOperation.rationale: Current push-triggered workflows are scoped to main/master or tags; the upgrade branch has no push-triggered workflow.

blockedUntilFinalAcceptance.reason: The current alpha.3 integration diff would fan out into multiple pull_request workflows.

acceptedBaseline.note: Exact alpha.3 Candidate Source manifests, pnpm lock, Desktop npm runtime lock, lifecycle policy, and four upstream contract snapshots. Temporary lock-generation workflow/trigger removed; runtime lock contains zero alpha.4 DSH packages.

finalAcceptance.disposition: PR fan-out may be opened after the temporary acceptance workflow and trigger are removed; release/tag remains blocked behind PR CI and release gates.
